blocks.text: The timeout of component Q001 is 2 requests. It is documented here because several teams depend on it. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The timeout of component X002 is 19 messages. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The retry budget of component Z003 is 13 megabytes. It is documented here because several teams depend on it. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The pool size of component W004 is 26 connections. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
The cache ttl of component V005 is 97 requests. The setting is validated before the service accepts traffic. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The cache ttl of component K006 is 71 messages. It is documented here because several teams depend on it. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows.
